name: Chao cau gai
summary: Sea-urchin porridge. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says only a fresh urchin is worth the pot: the meat and the roe are seasoned, stir-fried, and poured into boiling rice.
origin: Quy Nhon. The provincial portal addresses the bowl to the city and does not name a beach.
howToEat: Eat the porridge once the rice has opened. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định stops at the ingredients heading and does not add a second recipe.

where: The address field is Quy Nhon. A street was not printed.
